episodes.synopsis: Kotake and a group of boys decide to bicycle to Mount Fuji. Doremi, Hazuki, and Aiko have to convince him otherwise.
episodes.title: Messed Up Cycling ~The Boys' Secret~

episodes.synopsis: Momoko meets Onpu at New York and tells a story of what happened before she became a witch apprentice.
episodes.title: New York's MAHO Dou ~Momoko's Secret~

episodes.synopsis: The swim meet is nearing and Aiko has been chosen as Anchor for her class. There's only one problem, though...
episodes.title: The Value of Swimming! ~Aiko's Secret~

episodes.synopsis: Onpu cannot decide on a role for a movie and she reflects on what made her become an idol.
episodes.title: Non-standard ~Onpu's Secret~

episodes.synopsis: The trouble with Hana is that she isn't potty-trained.
episodes.title: Someone Who Knows the Sorrow ~Pop and Hana's Secret~

episodes.synopsis: When Baaya was younger, she fell in love at first sight with two things. The first was ballet, the other a boy.
episodes.title: Sugar Candy Memory ~Baaya's Secret~

episodes.synopsis: The son of a Taiyaki maker is fed up with his father criticizing him, and goes to the Maho-do to start his business.
episodes.title: I Love Taiyaki! ~The Parent and Child's Secret~

episodes.synopsis: When a flute is broken by an honor student with a crush, Onpu takes the blame.
episodes.title: Recorder Test! ~The Honor Student's Secret~

episodes.synopsis: Momoko, inspired by two baseball lovers, makes a team of her own friends and they compete with their first team...
episodes.title: Baseball Club ~The Witches' Secret~

episodes.synopsis: Aiko reunites with Anrima, who made a promise to her when she was younger.
episodes.title: Wedding Promise ~Childhood Friends' Secret~

episodes.synopsis: Once upon a time; every Valentine's Day, Hazuki and Masaru swap gifts. There's a reason why they stopped.
episodes.title: Valentine's Day ~Hazuki's Secret~

episodes.synopsis: Doremi meets a girl named Nozomi in the hospital, who is a fan of witches. She vowed to her, despite her Cancer, that she would become a Witch Apprentice.
episodes.title: The Seventh Witch Apprentice ~Non-chan's Secret~

episodes.synopsis: Doremi meets a mysterious girl named Fami, who shares similar traits with her.
episodes.title: The Doll That Leapt Through Time ~Doremi's Secret~
